reapack.name: reaper-pad.ext
reapack.desc: reaper-pad: use a USB gamepad as a remote control for REAPER

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog:
First public version.
Added: - REAPER extension that calls the REAPER API directly (Linux and Windows). - Actions: *Reload configuration*, *Enable/disable gamepad*, *Button test (console)*. - Smooth horizontal zoom. - Variable-speed sticks, D-pad auto-repeat, contact-bounce filter. - Rumble on record start/stop and a gentle startup buzz. - Configuration validation with clear error messages. - Unit tests and CI for Linux and Windows.

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog:
Added: - ReaPack repository: install and update reaper-pad from REAPER (`https://github.com/MickCh/reaper-pad/raw/main/index.xml`). - Digital-mode detection for DragonRise pads (Art AG-16T and clones): when the LED is green the right stick presses buttons 1–4, so reaper-pad buzzes three times, prints a warning in the REAPER console and ignores buttons 1–4 until the pad is back in analog mode. Option `detect_digital_mode`.
Changed: - Library files are named by architecture (`reaper_pad-x86_64.so`, `reaper_pad-x64.dll`), like other REAPER extensions. Remove an older manually installed `reaper_pad.so` / `reaper_pad.dll`.

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog:
Added: - docs/hardware.md: Art AG-16T measurements (analog vs digital mode) and diagnostic scripts in scripts/diag.
Changed: - Configuration format: stick settings moved into [sticks.left] and [sticks.right] (x, y, speed, invert_y, axis_x, axis_y); [sticks] keeps the shared ones. Replaces left_x, speed_left, invert_left_y etc. and [pad] axis_*. Update your reaper-pad.toml: the old names are reported as unknown options (see the default config.toml). - The button test names D-pad positions ("D-pad left-down"). - The gamepad is closed (and its motors stopped) when REAPER exits.
Fixed: - Release notes in ReaPack no longer show Markdown backticks. - A pad button bound to one of reaper-pad's own actions (e.g. Reload configuration) now works; it used to do nothing. - nan and inf in [sticks] are rejected instead of being passed to REAPER.

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog:
Changed: - Options from the 0.3 configuration format (left_x, speed_left, [pad] axis_left_x etc.) are reported with their new place instead of as unknown options.
Fixed: - The toolbar buttons of Enable/disable gamepad and Button test no longer flicker off when REAPER refreshes them while the gamepad is in use.

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog: Changed: - Internal clean-up, no change in behaviour: command names and REAPER action IDs are checked at compile time, typed errors for invalid commands, rumble feedback separated from input handling.

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog: Changed: - A configuration with options from 0.3 also reports its other errors at once, not only after the renamed options are fixed.

version.author: MickCh
version.changelog: Changed: - Errors reported together with renamed 0.3 options show their line in the file, and the renamed options are listed in unusual files too.
